mentions.name: FaderBuddy
mentions.description: FaderBuddy is a plug-and-play controller board for driving motorized faders with ESPHome and other microcontrollers. It pairs an ATtiny1616 with a motor driver on a small board that mounts to the bottom of Behringer MF60T replacement faders and exposes an I2C interface for reading fader position, moving to a specific spot, and setting up haptic detents — a linear take on the author's SmartKnob project. Suited to builds like an intuitive smart light dimmer switch or a macropad.
mentions.problem: Using motorized faders with ESPHome and other microcontrollers is not easy, so the board makes that integration plug-and-play.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building a plug-and-play controller to use motorized faders with ESPHome and other microcontrollers easily, called FaderBuddy.
